title: The Alchemy of Happiness
author: Al-Ghazali (Field trans)
description: Al-Ghazali explores self-knowledge, religious practice and the cultivation of the heart. The work presents happiness as a spiritual transformation rooted in understanding the self and its relationship with God.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/alchemyofhappine00algh).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
